status: LABEL_PROTOCOL_FROZEN_BEFORE_COMPOSITION; generator recipe and source admission still required
objective: Construct controlled newly occluded versus outside target support on public real source pixels with certified original visible ownership. Data-first audit; no model training yet.

scope.source: Existing public YCB-V original TRAIN scenes0..7 and VAL scenes8..9 only; same original split for target and independent occluder.
scope.current223: Excluded by immutable image SHA manifest. No private RGB, visibility labels, reference coordinates or scores read or used in v66 design/composition/selection.
scope.new_public_pallet: Not admitted by this protocol. License, mask/geometry provenance and capture-family separation require separate admission; unknown evidence means HOLD.
scope.semantic_self: UNKNOWN; optional saved-pose geometry remains a separate proxy, never controlled pixel supervision.

source_assumptions.original_visible_positive: orig_vis1 is accepted source GT for an observed target-owned pixel. This is native public mask membership, not semantic corner truth.
source_assumptions.original_visible_negative: orig_vis0 is accepted source-visible-mask negative under the explicit completeness assumption of this source mask. It certifies no observed target-visible pixel at that native pixel, NOT hidden target-full ownership.
source_assumptions.original_full_negative: orig_full0 is accepted source target-full-negative support, including target holes/background; preserve original source-mask provenance.
source_assumptions.original_hidden_full: orig_full1 andorig_vis0 does not certify hidden full support for CONTROLLED truth. Full membership and exact3state class remain UNKNOWN, even when newly pasted.
source_assumptions.source_mask_noise: BOP rendered/depth masks are still source annotations. Preserve boundary/void/depth attributes and original proxy labels; no certified human physical-corner or natural-occlusion claim.

composition.first_recipe: Opaque binary paste support only. Any later antialiased/partial alpha pixels require explicit uncertainty rules and a new preregistration; never silently call partial coverage fully hidden.
composition.target_identity: Tracked target remains the original source instance. A pasted real object is another layer/instance even if visually similar or same class.
composition.occluder: RGB and original visible mask from a DIFFERENT source image SHA in the SAME original split; original source visible mask only, never full-mask hidden extensions.
composition.layer: Apply a fixed registered geometric transform and clipping; paste_mask is the actual final opaque support. Ground truth uses actual pasted support, not a proposed box or unclipped mask.
RGB_proof: Outside paste_mask compositeRGB equals original target RGB byte-for-byte.
Inside paste_mask compositeRGB equals transformed occluder RGB byte-for-byte.
composition.input_geometry: Same frozen original target query8/side/roughbox; no reference/corner repair or crop adjustment from new pasted labels.
composition.recipe_status: Root must register exact target/occluder pools, seeded transforms, placement/count schedule, query set, resampling/border rules and hashes in GENERATION_RECIPE.json before any composition. This label contract fixes no outcome-driven numeric search.

pixel_certainty.visible_known: True under explicit original-visible-mask completeness assumption; do not derive this merely from classUNKNOWN.
pixel_certainty.original_proxy: Save original V/E_PROXY/O separately; never relabel original hidden proxy as controlled E or O.

native_query.pixel: floor(native_query+.5); continuous and rounded coordinates must both be in native image.
native_query.exact: Radius0 membership/certainty at that unchanged nearest native pixel.
native_query.radius2: Clipped native5x5 square centered at the same nearest native pixel; no dilation in resized crop pixels.
native_query.invalid: Mask invalid native queries and losses; do not relabel invalid as O.

window_certainty.visible_positive: Any known-visible pixel implies V regardless of unknown-full neighbors.
window_certainty.visible_negative: All native window pixels must have known visible-negative status to certify no V. If any visibility bit is untrusted/unknown and no positive V exists, window visible status is UNKNOWN.
window_certainty.full_positive: Any certified full-positive pixel (orig_vis1) implies window full support; unknown-full neighbors do not invalidate this existential positive.
window_certainty.full_negative: EVERY window pixel must be certified full-negative (~orig_full). No known full-positive alone is insufficient; any unknown-full pixel blocks O.
radius2_class: Else O ifallfullknownnegative (which also implies no target visible).
window_certainty.E_window_assumption: When unknown-full pixels occur in an E window, no-visible certainty relies explicitly on original-visible-mask completeness; it is not an exact controlled-E label on those unknown pixels.
window_certainty.strict_E_core: All native window pixels are orig_vis1 AND paste_mask1. This is the strongest fully newly occluded owned-target5x5 certificate; report separately.
window_certainty.strict_O_core: All native window pixels are orig_full0; paste does not change target outside truth.
no_shortcuts: Never map U to O or count absence of known full positives as full-negative.
Never turn orig_full1vis0 into exact controlledE, even when covered.
Never create semantic self labels from masks or paste.

partial_joint.unique_joint: Assign one6statecode only when both exact andradius2 states are known and compatible; otherwise joint_code=-1 and joint_known=False.
partial_joint.compatibility: Save compatible6statebitset from known visible/full facts. With visible-knownnegative butfullunknown, possible exact/near classes are{E,O}; retain partial certainty instead of padding a class.
partial_joint.training_status: No training/loss choice is admitted here. Later training must explicitly register dropping unknowns versus a compatible-state partial likelihood; never ordinaryCE on paddedU.

OV_and_semantics.exact: OV is exact outside target support with visible target within fixed native radius2; it is NOT external occlusion.
OV_and_semantics.practical: A predictedOV may suggest finite query/support mismatch. It does not prove initial-coordinate error or that a semantic corner is visible.
OV_and_semantics.corner_truth: Human/native-corner visibility and target-pixel ownership remain different targets. Source pseudoqueries supply pixel/window support truth only; no new corner semantics.

data_audits_required_before_admission: Verify original masks0/255binary, visible subsetfull, image/mask shape and source SHA.
Verify target and occluder source-image SHAs differ and both belong to the same fixed original split.
Verify no target/occluder/output image SHA overlaps excluded current223; no TRAIN/VAL source image or recording scene overlap.
Reconstruct actual opaque paste RGB pixel invariants and exact V/E/O/U partition independently.
Independently verify native exact/radius2 certainty and all joint compatibility including unknown neighborhoods, borders and ties.
Retain original proxy E, unknown-full coverage, source and paste boundaries, void/depthmissing and class/object IDs as audit attributes, never input features.
Freeze all generation recipes, manifests, input hashes and generated hashes; preserve failed artifacts with reason instead of silent corrections.

source_validation.split: Original disjoint source scenes/images retained for target AND occluder; no augmented sibling or reused occluder RGB across TRAIN/VAL.
source_validation.frozen_queries: Query set, placement dose, transformed-occluder pool and subgroup sizes fixed before generator run; all fixed examples reported, no filtered easy/private-favored subset.
source_validation.counterfactual_pairs: Pair original/zero-new-occlusion and composed views at identical target/query/box. Controlled E evaluation uses orig_vis1 newly covered; target-outside O remains separate.
report: Exact andradius2 known/unknown denominators and class counts.
Controlled E versus observed V versus known O confusion, precision/recall/coverage with all eligible GT in denominators.
Strict newly-occluded5x5 E core and strict outside O core separately.
Original unknown-full, source/paste boundaries and paste-interior strata; hiddenproxy remains separate.
Per source target object, occluder object, source scene/frame and occlusion dose; held-out original YCB objects.
Counterfactual V->E response versus unchanged O predictions and unchanged V controls.
Controlled-compositor performance separately from untouched original source-proxy evaluation.
source_validation.selection: No model/threshold/runtime/architecture selection from current223. Future checkpoint criterion must be frozen after data admission and before training.
source_validation.risk: Hard seams and crop/box source conditioning can make controlled validation easy while failing natural occlusion. Passing controlled labels or generator tests alone is not natural-real transfer success.

admission.release: Only after root independently accepts deterministic recipe, exclusion/split/causal-label audits and controlled class/window certainty. No new training before admission.
